PFC.description: Prefrontal cortex (medial/orbital/cingulate frontal); ACA overlap with ACC group is intentional

dlPFC.description: Dorsolateral PFC homolog in mouse (prelimbic + dorsal ACA + lateral orbital)

vmPFC.description: Ventromedial PFC homolog in mouse (infralimbic + ventral ACA + medial orbital + frontal pole)

AMY.description: Amygdala (杏仁核); cortical and subcortical amygdalar nuclei

PVH.description: Paraventricular nucleus of hypothalamus (下丘脑室旁核); Allen PVH includes subdivisions

PMC.description: Pontine micturition center homolog in mouse: Barrington's nucleus (Allen acronym B, id 280)

ACG.description: Anterior cingulate gyrus (前扣带回); Allen mouse atlas uses ACA

ACC.description: Alias of ACG (anterior cingulate); may overlap PFC group points
